name: Pizza Frenzy Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends what the original left to chance, and changes nothing else: its look, rules, sounds and pace of play stay as they were. Each fix is a toggle; with the whole mod off the game is the original.

settings.label: Timing from the frames
settings.help: The original times each frame by the machine's clock, so a frame that comes late moves the customers' waits, the vans, the level's clock and the tips further, and the random waits between customers land on different frames: the same clicks never play the same game twice. With the fix every frame is one thirtieth of a second of the game's time, so the same seed and the same clicks play the same game on every run.
